calibration_note: prior = probability that a quick, time-boxed attempt yields the stated kernel-checked (or, where marked, Tier C) result. It is NOT the probability of a major breakthrough; no item here is a major breakthrough at 40%. impact = expected value to science/people if it succeeds (low/medium/high), judged before the attempt.

hypotheses.title: Dipolar (interlayer) exciton crystals are triangular
hypotheses.statement: For every d > 0, g_d(t) = 2(t^{-1/2} - (t+d^2)^{-1/2}) is AdmissiblePotential; hence the triangular lattice minimises the energy of the bilayer electron-hole (indirect exciton) interaction among locally finite density-one configurations. Negative control: t^{-1/2} - 2(t+d^2)^{-1/2} is not admissible.
hypotheses.kill: two 45-min attempts fail, or the negative control turns out admissible

hypotheses.title: The dipolar-exciton lattice energy is finite (non-vacuity)
hypotheses.statement: latticeEnergy g_d < top, via g_d(t) <= (d^2) t^{-3/2} and RieszFinite at s = 3.

hypotheses.title: Yukawa / Debye-Hueckel crystals are triangular
hypotheses.statement: For kappa > 0, g(t) = exp(-kappa sqrt t)/sqrt t is AdmissiblePotential, through a reusable product-closure lemma (admissible * admissible is admissible) and exp(-kappa sqrt t) admissible.
hypotheses.kill: two attempts fail on Leibniz or composition

hypotheses.title: Rytova-Keldysh (screened 2D-material) interaction is completely monotone in r^2
hypotheses.statement: The Keldysh potential V(r) = (pi/(2 r0)) [H0(r/r0) - Y0(r/r0)] equals a Gaussian mixture with explicit positive weight w(a) = (1/r0) e^{a/r0^2} erfc(sqrt(a)/r0) (Laplace in k^2 of its 2D Fourier transform 2 pi/(k(1+r0 k))); hence it lies in the theorem's class. Tier C proof + Tier X numerics (mixture integral vs Struve-Neumann formula; derivative signs).
hypotheses.toolchain: python (scipy) + human proof; Lean only if a mixture-to-admissible lemma is proved (H3L, stretch)
hypotheses.kill: the numerics disagree with the mixture formula beyond 1e-8 relative, or any derivative sign fails

hypotheses.title: Montgomery's lattice theorem in Lean
hypotheses.statement: Among lattices of covolume 1 in R^2 the triangular lattice uniquely minimises the theta function theta_L(alpha) for every alpha > 0 (strict, up to isometry).
hypotheses.kill: not attempted this round beyond scoping

hypotheses.title: Population genetics I: Wright-Fisher fixation probability equals initial frequency
hypotheses.statement: In the neutral Wright-Fisher chain on {0..N} the probability of absorption at N from i equals i/N. First formalization of a known result.

hypotheses.title: Population genetics II: Fisher's fundamental theorem, one locus, two alleles
hypotheses.statement: Under discrete-generation viability selection with Hardy-Weinberg proportions, mean fitness does not decrease: wbar(p') >= wbar(p), and Delta p = p q (dwbar/dp)/(2 wbar). First formalization of a known result.
